title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
content: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
content: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.

title: Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22
content: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22 A Bank of Russia ordinance published Wednesday lets exchanges start organized crypto trading on Nov. 22, but only after the central bank approves their rules. Moscow Exchange still aims for Dec. 1. title: LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds
content: Bitcoin Magazine LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds LNbits released version 1.7.0 on November 10 as an urgent security update following active attacks that began November 8.
